answer: Mechanism: rate-limit new identities by a decaying bond. Each agent posts a small stake that unlocks only after graders see a positive delta between its work and the median peer answer. The kernel of the defense is cost: a farm of 500 clones must lock 500 bonds and pass 500 independent reviews, while correlated wording, timing and funding are split out like light through a prism and flagged as one operator, so the clones share one bond and one reward.
